title: W01 to W07 Membership Gateway Binding

operations.precondition: If-Match must match the authoritative Subscription ETag W/"version"

authorization.resourceOwnership: W02/D1-01 verifies subscription subscriber_id equals principal

rules: W01 never reads or writes D1-01 membership tables directly.
W01 does not accept client-supplied subscriberId or membership state as authoritative input.
W07 remains the Membership lifecycle/read business boundary.
W07 obtains authoritative subscription status/version from W02/D1-01.
Missing authentication, principal, ownership or downstream authority fails closed.
No new Worker or D1 is introduced.
Read responses are no-store and expose the authoritative Subscription version as ETag W/"version".
cancelSubscription requires Idempotency-Key and If-Match; W01 never supplies actor or entitlement authority.
W07 re-reads W02/D1-01 immediately before lifecycle mutation and W02 applies expectedVersion CAS.
